items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets, flush coolant and change oil
items.note: YourMechanic estimates run about $630–$1,185 for this job on a Bonneville. If coolant got into the oil, the engine may need more work.

items.t: Cracked plastic upper intake manifold
items.job: Replace upper intake manifold and gaskets
items.note: Owners report an average of about $700.

items.t: Automatic transmission fails or won't go into gear
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report an average of about $2,300. A used transmission costs less.

items.t: Harsh or erratic shifting
items.job: Replace transmission pressure control solenoid
items.note: If internal parts are already damaged, the repair costs much more; owners report an average of about $1,400.

items.t: Power window drops into the door or stops working
items.job: Replace power window regulator
items.note: Owners report about $300–$500; YourMechanic estimates run about $330–$950 depending on the door.

items.t: Water leaks into the car or trunk
items.job: Water-test and reseal leaking seams or seals
items.note: Owners report an average of about $600.

items.t: Engine stalls or surges while driving
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor or mass airflow sensor
items.note: Owners report an average of about $200.

items.t: Car won't start or starts only sometimes
items.job: Diagnose no-start and replace ignition switch or failed part
items.note: Owners of some older cars report much higher bills when several parts were replaced.

items.t: Heat and A/C blow from the wrong vents or at the wrong temperature
items.job: Replace HVAC mode or blend door actuator

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge

items.t: Airbag or seat belt warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and replace failed buckle or sensor
items.note: Owners report an average of about $700.

items.t: Clunk from the steering when turning
items.job: Lubricate or replace intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Misfire or rough idle from fuel injector problems
items.job: Clean or replace fuel injectors, or repair injector connectors

items.t: Oil leak from the oil pan or rear main seal
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket or rear main seal
items.note: The low end is an oil pan gasket; a rear main seal needs the transmission out and costs much more.

items.t: Harsh clunk into drive or reverse when cold
items.job: Diagnose transmission and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Rusted floor under the rear-seat battery
items.job: Treat or patch floor pan corrosion under the battery

items.t: Whine or hum from the alternator in the cabin
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Paint bubbling on the aluminum hood
items.job: Strip and refinish hood

items.t: Paint peeling off the hood and roof
items.job: Sand and repaint hood and roof
items.note: Owners report an average of about $2,200; body shop rates vary.

items.t: Tilt steering column sticks in one position
items.job: Repair tilt mechanism in steering column

items.t: Wrong spark plugs installed at the factory (campaign)
items.job: Inspect and replace spark plugs (emissions campaign)

items.t: Leaking fuel pressure regulator can cause a backfire and fire (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pressure regulator (recall 04V-090)

items.t: Backfire can break the intake and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Intake backfire recall repair (96V-116)

items.t: Key and seat belt reminder chimes may not sound (recall)
items.job: Anti-theft and chime recall repair (95V-204)

items.t: Gear indicator may not match the actual gear (recall)
items.job: Shift indicator link recall repair (99V-089)

items.t: Aluminum wheel may separate from the car (recall)
items.job: Wheel recall inspection and repair (99V-072)

items.t: ABS and stability control unit may not work properly (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace brake hydraulic control unit (recall 00V-114)

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can break apart (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace driver airbag module (recall 02V-222)

items.t: Fuel can leak during refueling (recall)
items.job: Fuel tank pressure sensor recall repair (03V-238)
